name: svg-french-press-pareto-s1-r4
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="950" height="1360" viewBox="0 0 950 1360" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="steelV" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4f6f7"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#c9d0d5"/>
      <stop offset="0.8" stop-color="#a8b1b8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d6dbdf"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rodG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f0f2f3"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#aab3b9"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#7f888e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#dfe3e5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="knobG" cx="0.38" cy="0.32" r="0.75">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6a7278"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#3a4046"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#17191c"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="lidTop" cx="0.42" cy="0.38" r="0.8">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4a5157"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#2c3136"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1d2125"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eaf6fb"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#cfe7f1"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b6d7e4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="6.5" height="6.5" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M6.5,0 H0 V6.5" fill="none" stroke="#79848c" stroke-width="0.9"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <!-- background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="950" height="1360" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="60" y="56" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#22282e" letter-spacing="2">FRENCH PRESS</text>
  <text x="60" y="86" font-size="20" fill="#5a646c">Exploded assembly diagram</text>

  <!-- axis -->
  <line x1="450" y1="96" x2="450" y2="1270" stroke="#b9c2c8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 8"/>

  <!-- ===================== 1 KNOB ===================== -->
  <rect x="444" y="140" width="12" height="26" fill="#33383d"/>
  <circle cx="450" cy="118" r="32" fill="url(#knobG)" stroke="#14171a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="438" cy="105" rx="11" ry="8" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- ===================== 2 LID ===================== -->
  <path d="M300,228 A150,40 0 0 0 600,228 L600,244 A150,40 0 0 1 300,244 Z" fill="#2d3237"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="228" rx="150" ry="40" fill="url(#lidTop)" stroke="#14171a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M402,212 A48,13 0 0 0 498,212 L498,224 A48,13 0 0 1 402,224 Z" fill="#262b30"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="212" rx="48" ry="13" fill="#343a40" stroke="#14171a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="212" rx="9" ry="3" fill="#0c0e10"/>

  <!-- ===================== 3 PLUNGER ROD ===================== -->
  <rect x="445" y="300" width="10" height="315" fill="url(#rodG)" stroke="#7c848a" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  <g stroke="#7c848a" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="445" y1="306" x2="455" y2="306"/>
    <line x1="445" y1="311" x2="455" y2="311"/>
    <line x1="445" y1="316" x2="455" y2="316"/>
    <line x1="445" y1="585" x2="455" y2="585"/>
    <line x1="445" y1="591" x2="455" y2="591"/>
    <line x1="445" y1="597" x2="455" y2="597"/>
    <line x1="445" y1="603" x2="455" y2="603"/>
    <line x1="445" y1="609" x2="455" y2="609"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===================== 4 SPIRAL SPRING ===================== -->
  <!-- Open spring plate; the peripheral coil seals the mesh to the glass. -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="681" rx="128" ry="36" fill="none" stroke="#89949c" stroke-width="12"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="681" rx="128" ry="36" fill="none" stroke="#eef1f3" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="681" rx="120" ry="31" fill="none" stroke="#76828b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M362,660 L538,702 M362,702 L538,660" fill="none" stroke="#75818a" stroke-width="13"/>
  <path d="M362,660 L538,702 M362,702 L538,660" fill="none" stroke="#c9d1d7" stroke-width="9"/>
  <path d="M438,681 A12,4 0 0 0 462,681 L462,687 A12,4 0 0 1 438,687 Z" fill="#7d868d"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="681" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#aeb6bc" stroke="#6f7880" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="681" rx="4" ry="1.4" fill="#5a646c"/>

  <!-- ===================== 5 MESH SCREEN ===================== -->
  <path d="M315,780 A135,38 0 0 0 585,780 L585,788 A135,38 0 0 1 315,788 Z" fill="#9aa3aa"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="780" rx="135" ry="38" fill="url(#steelV)"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="780" rx="135" ry="38" fill="url(#mesh)" opacity="0.55"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="780" rx="135" ry="38" fill="none" stroke="#79838b" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="780" rx="124" ry="34.5" fill="none" stroke="#7e8890" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.55"/>

  <ellipse cx="450" cy="780" rx="9" ry="3" fill="white" stroke="#6f7880" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- ===================== 6 CROSS PLATE ===================== -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="879" rx="128" ry="35" fill="none" stroke="#7d8992" stroke-width="12"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="875" rx="128" ry="35" fill="none" stroke="#c2cbd2" stroke-width="12"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="875" rx="134" ry="38" fill="none" stroke="#79838b" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M359,850 L541,900 M359,900 L541,850" fill="none" stroke="#77838c" stroke-width="20"/>
  <path d="M359,847 L541,897 M359,897 L541,847" fill="none" stroke="#cbd2d7" stroke-width="16"/>
  <path d="M433,865 A17,6 0 0 0 467,865 L467,877 A17,6 0 0 1 433,877 Z" fill="url(#rodG)" stroke="#78838b"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="865" rx="17" ry="6" fill="#e2e6e9" stroke="#78838b"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="865" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#424d56"/>

  <!-- ===================== 7 GLASS CARAFE ===================== -->
  <path d="M300,1000 C302,1100 304,1165 318,1216 A132,33 0 0 0 582,1216 C596,1165 598,1100 600,1000 A150,40 0 0 0 300,1000 Z"
        fill="url(#glass)" opacity="0.55" stroke="#7fa8b8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1000" rx="150" ry="40" fill="#d8ecf4" opacity="0.5" stroke="#7fa8b8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1000" rx="136" ry="35" fill="#b8d6e2" opacity="0.55" stroke="#8fb5c4" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <path d="M318,1216 A132,33 0 0 0 582,1216 L582,1230 A132,33 0 0 1 318,1230 Z" fill="#a9c8d6" opacity="0.8" stroke="#7fa8b8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1230" rx="132" ry="33" fill="#c9e2ec" opacity="0.85" stroke="#7fa8b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1226" rx="106" ry="24" fill="#b7d5e1" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M312,986 Q262,986 244,1002 Q264,1022 316,1018 Z" fill="#cfe6f0" opacity="0.9" stroke="#7fa8b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M596,1016 C672,1022 694,1056 694,1102 C694,1152 662,1178 584,1186" fill="none" stroke="#7fa8b8" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M596,1016 C672,1022 694,1056 694,1102 C694,1152 662,1178 584,1186" fill="none" stroke="#d5e9f1" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="318" y="1046" width="16" height="178" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.45"/>
  <rect x="342" y="1058" width="6" height="150" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- ===================== CALLOUTS ===================== -->
  <g stroke="#8a949b" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="486" y1="118" x2="674" y2="118"/>
    <line x1="604" y1="228" x2="674" y2="228"/>
    <line x1="458" y1="455" x2="674" y2="455"/>
    <line x1="569" y1="690" x2="674" y2="690"/>
    <line x1="589" y1="780" x2="674" y2="780"/>
    <line x1="589" y1="875" x2="674" y2="875"/>
    <line x1="702" y1="1112" x2="744" y2="1112"/>
    <line x1="312" y1="1150" x2="231" y2="1150"/>
    <line x1="248" y1="1002" x2="231" y2="1002"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#8a949b">
    <circle cx="486" cy="118" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="604" cy="228" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="458" cy="455" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="569" cy="690" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="589" cy="780" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="589" cy="875" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="312" cy="1150" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="248" cy="1002" r="3"/>
  </g>

  <g font-size="21" fill="#2b3138">
    <g font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
      <circle cx="690" cy="118" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="690" y="123">1</text>
      <circle cx="690" cy="228" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="690" y="233">2</text>
      <circle cx="690" cy="455" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="690" y="460">3</text>
      <circle cx="690" cy="690" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="690" y="695">4</text>
      <circle cx="690" cy="780" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="690" y="785">5</text>
      <circle cx="690" cy="875" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="690" y="880">6</text>
      <circle cx="760" cy="1105" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="760" y="1110">8</text>
      <circle cx="215" cy="1150" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="215" y="1155">7</text>
      <circle cx="215" cy="1002" r="13" fill="#2b3138"/><text x="215" y="1007">9</text>
    </g>
    <text x="712" y="124">Knob</text>
    <text x="712" y="234">Lid / rod guide</text>
    <text x="712" y="461">Plunger rod</text>
    <text x="712" y="696">Spring plate</text>
    <text x="712" y="718" font-size="15" fill="#5a646c">Coiled perimeter seal</text>
    <text x="712" y="786">Mesh screen</text>
    <text x="712" y="881">Cross plate</text>
    <text x="712" y="903" font-size="15" fill="#5a646c">Threaded filter support</text>
    <text x="782" y="1111">Handle</text>
    <text x="193" y="1156" text-anchor="end">Glass carafe</text>
    <text x="193" y="1008" text-anchor="end">Pour spout</text>
  </g>

  <!-- notes -->
  <text x="475" y="1306" font-size="19" fill="#5a646c" text-anchor="middle">Three-piece plunger filter (4–6) threads onto the plunger rod (3).</text>
  <text x="475" y="1332" font-size="19" fill="#5a646c" text-anchor="middle">Rod passes through lid and filter; its lower end screws into the cross plate.</text>
</svg>
